title: Bigin related-list read returns empty instead of an error when the token lacks the scope
symptoms: A direct Notes read fails with 401 Invalid oauth scope
Every record appears to have zero notes
cause: A token whose scopes cover Pipelines but not Notes, Tasks or Calls gets an empty response from related-list endpoints rather than an error, while direct reads of those modules fail with an invalid scope error.
fix: Prove a read can return data before you report an absence: run it on a record you know has notes. Use a token that carries the scopes for every module you read.
apply: Self Client scope: ZohoBigin.modules.ALL,ZohoBigin.settings.READ; then GET /bigin/v2/Pipelines/{known_id}/Notes and expect at least one record
